description: This PHP source file defines a class 'FormatWithEducation' that implements a value formatting strategy using education data. It includes methods for retrieving a formatted education name based on an entity value (likely an ID), utilizing an EducationService to fetch data. The class is part of the OrangeHRM system, specifically within the Maintenance access strategy's format value namespace.

classes.name: FormatWithEducation
classes.description: Implements a value formatter that retrieves an education name based on an ID, using EducationService.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the name of the Education entity corresponding to the provided ID, or null if not found.

methods.name: getEducationService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of EducationService.
